sections.name: mission
sections.value: You are the coder for plan 018-convo-poller, a single unit, no PM; o-prime (rs name pij-binding-magpie) is your counterpart. Conversation ingest works but nothing runs it: every transcript rots from the moment a human last typed `conversation ingest`. Build the daemon-side poller that runs the EXISTING readers over the native session stores, keyed on FILES (never pij seat rows), bounded on cold start; make the rot visible in `status`/`doctor`; distinguish 'no session file yet' from 'not indexed'; fix the git-ai metrics-db path. Read assets/inputs/evidence.md first — it is why this packet exists and your ack must cite it.

value.text: YOUR TREE: /Users/jordanknight/substrate/flowspace/fs3-018-convo-poller (branch 018-convo-poller). Your seat's cwd is the MAIN CLONE at /Users/jordanknight/substrate/flowspace/flowspace3 — `cd` into the worktree for every shell command and prefix EVERY file-tool path with /Users/jordanknight/substrate/flowspace/fs3-018-convo-poller/. Never commit on main; never `git checkout` in the main clone.

Orient: read the impl-guide (architecture + unit row + risks), the plan (goals, ACs), evidence.md, and the two vendored reviews. Run `harness boot --json` in your worktree before changing anything. DOGFOOD FLOWSPACE: `flowspace3 search "<question>"` for every meaning-shaped question before grep (exact identifiers may still grep); report every miss or confusing envelope as friction.

THE WIRE: o-prime's rs name is pij-binding-magpie — `pij-rs send --from pij-flaky-jerusalem --to pij-binding-magpie --msg-id "$(uuidgen)" --body '<one line>'` lands as a real turn; use it for every edge (ack pointer, stop-and-asks, done). Files in .harness/temp/agent/ (<slug>-ack.md / -ask-NNN.md / -report.md) in YOUR worktree stay the durable record. Never pij adopt.

Ack FIRST: reply to o-prime with your read of the unit + a numbered implementation plan before writing code, INCLUDING: the cursor helper you will need (name, crate) or that none is needed; the catalog code name; whether a migration is needed (default: no). Corrections to the packet are welcome — bring evidence.

Implement using the /builder implement discipline: work t1..t8 in order, keep the execution log honest, tests alongside code — every test injects a TEMPDIR HOME; the real ~/.claude and ~/.omp are never read by a test.
Stay inside the fence (scope below). If the work forces you outside it, STOP and ask o-prime — that is a composition concern, not yours to solve unilaterally.

FROZEN, do not touch: the readers' ordinal/grouping rules (claude.rs:60-75, metrics_db.rs header), the cursor ledger semantics in tail.rs / ingest_cursors, `conversation_guid`. Changing any of these silently doubles stored conversations.

Done = `harness checks` green in YOUR worktree + the unit tests proving each AC + one mutation receipt per rule (comparison flipped → red; cap removed → red; probe order swapped → red), restored after. Report done to o-prime with the evidence and open the PR yourself; NEVER merge — o-prime merges and bounces prod.
Capture friction with `harness observe` the moment it bites; list, never clear the buffer.

OMP seat: use your LSP (go-to-definition, find-references, diagnostics) for symbol questions instead of text search; verify every LSP edit by exact read. If the Rust LSP is not configured in your seat, report it at ack rather than silently grepping for the whole packet.
DDOC MUTATION SURFACE: the GLOBAL `ddocs` CLI on PATH (`ddocs set` / `ddocs add` / `ddocs build <file>`). Never hand-edit .dd.json/.dd.md. Task states move to checked only with a receipt.

PROD :7373 is never a test target; read-only commands against it are fine. Per-run test DBs ONLY on :5434 (FS3_TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://flowspace3:flowspace3@127.0.0.1:5434/flowspace3_test, container flowspace3-db-test) — NEVER :5433; any scratch daemon uses FS3_CONFIG_DIR=<scratch> + an ephemeral port; one cargo invocation at a time; NEVER run `harness checks` while another seat's gate is running — ask o-prime for the slot.

TRIPWIRE: `cargo test -p fs3-providers --test conversation_sources` and the conversation goldens in `crates/cli/tests/envelope_goldens.rs` must stay green untouched. A red there means you changed a reader or an envelope you do not own — STOP and report; never investigate it away.

READS DECLARATION: you CONSUME `reconcile.rs` (trait + run_forever), `retention.rs` (tick pattern), `convo_ingest.rs` (submit_after, discover_folder/cwd_of, source_for), `fs3_store::ingest_cursors` and `enqueue_job`, `fs3_providers::conversation_sources::{claude,omp}` (resolve semantics only), `views/status.rs`, `doctor.rs` Step builders, `config.rs` IndexingConfig + Problem. Reading anything else is a stop-and-ask.

COST: the first prod pass will find ~100 in-window session files. Your cap + stagger design must be stated at ack with numbers (e.g. 10 per pass, 6s stagger), and the pass log must print enqueued/behind/skipped so o-prime can read the catch-up cost off the log.

ABSOLUTE PATHS ALWAYS for every file tool (edit/write/read), rooted at YOUR worktree. Do NOT `flowspace3 add` your worktree — search is a comprehension aid over the main index; bytes are verified in your own tree.
o-prime (pij-binding-magpie) is your interface: ack, stop-and-asks, done report — rs send + file.
DEFER to o-prime: anything outside the fence, migrations, dependency additions, anything that changes a public envelope shape beyond the additive fields named in the interface.
Your evidence outranks the packet: correct it at ack with a measurement.

value.fence: crates/daemon/src/convo_poll.rs (new), crates/daemon/src/convo_ingest.rs, crates/daemon/src/boot.rs (registration only), crates/daemon/src/status.rs, crates/core/src/views/status.rs (additive), crates/core/src/config.rs (two knobs + template), crates/core/src/catalog.rs (one code), crates/cli/src/doctor.rs, crates/cli/src/conversation.rs and status rendering, crates/store/src/** ONLY for a cursor bulk-read helper named at ack, crates/daemon/tests/**, crates/cli/tests/**, docs/plans/018-convo-poller/**, .harness/temp/agent/**. Fence is by RESPONSIBILITY: anything touching readers, ledger semantics, search, or the runner's claim loop is out and needs an ask.
value.forbidden_note: Never touch another unit's paths, .harness/government/**, or the plan's flow state. Open the PR yourself when the done-bar is met; NEVER merge it — o-prime merges. ABSOLUTE PATHS FOR EVERY FILE READ AND EDIT, ALWAYS, rooted at the worktree — your seat was spawned in the main clone and a relative path will edit the wrong tree while reporting success (DL-007/008, DL-044).

value.text: Unit implements the interface contract in the impl-guide row, verbatim or with o-prime-ruled amendments.
ac-0001..0007 each have a green test named in the execution log, plus the three mutation receipts (red then restored).
harness checks green in your worktree — AND prove the change is IN THE TREE YOU BUILT: cite tree-resident evidence (git status in the worktree, the module named in the build).
The SNAP-IN RECIPE shipped as a doc comment on ConvoPoller (config shape, construction, the boot.rs registration line) even though you wire it yourself — composition verifies rather than re-derives.
Done report to o-prime: what shipped, evidence, deviations, the cold-start numbers, and an explicit ASSUMPTIONS section (what you assumed about cursors, folders, and the runner).
